notes.title: 10.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
10.5.0 Update is here!
Today the 10.5.0 update will be rolling out on all platforms! Keep an eye out for when it becomes available as the time may vary. 

Patch notes:
- New Wasteland map
- New items added to the Shop
- Halloween Event started
- Fixed Party Mix being stuck on KoH
- Fixed bug that caused all weapons to have the same movement speed
- Increased Spawn Protection by 1 second
- Fixed Xbox achievements

Known bugs to be fixed next week:
- Robo Rob skin animated face doesn’t appear on PC

-
Thank you again to all our committed players and loyal fans! This will be the last content update of the year as we continue to focus on creating new games to share with you! More news to come regarding our next game which we plan to release in the next couple of months!

notes.title: 9.7.0 Update
notes.notes:
The 9.7.0 (Christmas) update has arrived! We've switched all of the text in the game to our new pixelated font, bringing a fresh look to the UI. Don't miss your chance to get the limited-time Christmas items from the event shop!

Additions/Changes

 Christmas Event started
 All text updated to use new font
 New Settings menu with new options
 Battle Passes now take less time to complete
 Elite Pass double xp shows properly in-game
 Nametags are now only visible within a close distance
 RPG rockets no longer collide with the player who shot it
 Many weapon balance changes (see Discord)
 Sniper scope sway and flinch has been reduced
 Server select moved to Settings menu
 Player’s platform now visible in Scoreboard and Profile
 Updated mouse locking system to prevent losing your cursor
 Pull-out animations sped up for M60 and RPD
 Weapon slots now show icons for equipped weapon skins
 Removed level restrictions to play game modes
 Various bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Halloween Update 🎃 (9.0.0)
notes.notes:
The Halloween update is here - and it's huge! This is one of our biggest updates ever, with tons of new content, bug fixes, and more.

[previewyoutube=HkK0cpByUVw;full][/previewyoutube]

Additions/Changes

 Halloween Season & Event
 Retro Mall map
 New weapon: RPD
 Emoji Reactions
 Major rework of hip fire bullet spread accuracy
 Minimum damage from range drop-off has been reduced from 50% of base damage to 20% of base damage
 Each weapon now has its own ADS Speed which is listed in the Loadouts menu
 The Recoil stat of each weapon is now listed in the Loadouts menu
 PC and Mobile players are no longer separated in FFA, TDM, and Gun Game. (Previously these were the only modes that were separated)
 Aim Assist for Mobile and Controller players
 (Mobile) FOV Slider
 Full controller support for Mobile
 Headbob (with toggle)

 New Clan tag colors
 Improved server select menu

 Ragdolls no longer block player movement
 Removed default Pistol and Axe from cases
 Increased respawn timer for players who kill themselves
 Battle Royale map updated for Halloween
 Weapons/player arms no longer clip through objects
 Escape key now closes PC Settings in-game
 Enemy name tags are no longer visible in Bomb Defuse
 Gold Tactical Knife added to the shop



Bug Fixes/Improvements

 Fixed Bomb Defuse
 Fixed Spectator mode
 Fixed an issue where >100 players were not able to level up. All levels over 80 now require the same amount of XP
 Fixed bug that shows your cosmetics on other users in the Following menu
 Fixed lightweight and other perks
 Fixed bug where equipment would not be used and just sit in your hand
 Attachments now properly display on other players
 Fixed a bug that caused some Steam players to get stuck at 30% loading
 Fixed bug where players would appear to be running after a game ended
 Fixed a bug where the Respawn menu would show an enemy with negative health
 Fixed flickering screen in Respawn menu
 Fixed Bundle UI popup
 Fixed slow scrolling of Loadouts menu (ingame) and Training maps list
 Fixed Spy Watch Animation 
 Elite Rifle now has sound
 Fixed Sombrero Skins 
 Spy Pistol Red Dot Aligned properly
 Christmas Lights removed from Little Town
 Fixed Donut Trail lighting
 Fixed Christmas Village Menu Background 
 Fixed Summer Garden Background pink water



Weapon Balance Changes:

 AR60 hip fire recoil reduced
 Army Rifle hip fire recoil increased
 Vector range reduced
 Reduced RPG 1-hit kill radius
 (PC) Added keybinds to various buttons throughout the game
 The damage of most weapons has been increased by 10%
 The range of most primary rifles has been increased by 10

notes.title: Version 8.1.0 (PC Release!)
notes.notes:
Pixel Strike 3D has been fully released on PC! Thanks to everyone who helped test during the beta! If you find any bugs or have any questions make sure you join our Discord server!

Patch notes:
- New weapons: Combat Rifle, SX2, MP7
- New equipment: Smoke Grenade
- New Death Run map: Ancient Pyramid
- New cosmetic items
- Grenade danger indicator
- Red hitmarker on kill
- Spectator mode fixes
- Lots of bug fixes and improvements

PC Changes:
- Graphics settings (FOV, Post Processing, Bloom, Motion Blur, AA)
- Keybind controls editor
- Audio volume sliders
- Mobile account linking

Weapon balance changes
Elite Rifle - Damage and fire rate reduced
50 Cal - Damage reduced
MP40 - Damage reduced
Army Pistol - Damage reduced
Tek Rifle - Damage increased
A180 - Bursts increased to 4
Special Forces Rifle - Damage increased
AK49 - Magazine ammo increased to 30
Sheriff Pistols - Fire rate increased
TEC-9 - Damage and fire rate increased
